description: Search the web using the Firecrawl Search API - returns clean search results with titles, links, and snippets

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-100)

outputs.name: items
outputs.description: Array of cleaned search result items with title, link, displayLink, snippet, and position

outputs.name: warning
outputs.description: Any warning message returned by the Firecrawl API
